attBesluta.text: The table is so stable with the wheels. I use mine as a Table that I pull in and out from my workshop/office where I store my Pizza Oven Macte box with the flour and everything I have to use when I make my pizza so I have wheel everything to my outdoor Kitchen area.
Sehr robust und für den Preis unschlagbar. Habe die Höhe gekürzt. Geht problemlos
Supersnygg, över förväntan. Kommer köpa en eller två till:)
Très bon article, juste un coup dans la tranche de la table, c'est dommage.
Vise showed up on time and as described. Works great. I love it.
it’s a large vise that I mounted on my 400lb welding table. seems sturdy and ii expect it to last a long time.

The spray paint shelter is very functional. Have used it multiple times to good effect. The back sags a little even when pegged out so I added a guy point to pull the back out a bit. Contains the spray well, keeps insects off fresh paint and very roomy for most small to midsize project. A good, cost effective product.
Super god kabine Jeg bruger den jævnligt i mit værksted
I bought the Spray tent from Vevor, for what I want to use it for, spraying outside it does the job well.

This tent took me less than 10 minutes to set up on my own. I was initially skeptical, but it proved to be excellent for my spraying project in the garage. I placed a fan and a furnace filter through the outside opening to efficiently exhaust the paint mist, and it handled the job with ease. Recommended.
Works good for the price. Be better if it was a little taller and wider at the top. But overall im satisfied
Este de o calitate bună. Îl folosesc pentru a scoate fumul de sudură. Era bine daca avea mai multe cleme de prindere.
je recommande manque juste des cales pour pas que le chariot roule en dehors du support
Die Planfräsvorrichtung ist gut gemacht, sauber verarbeitet. Einzig die verbauten Rollen haben zu viel Spiel in der Lagerung das wirkt recht billig.
Mega handig. Geen los hangende en flapperende slierten. De verlengstukken zijn ook een gemakkelijke extra.
Great to have everything you need in one bag and with the extra belts make things easier to tie down anything you put in the back of the pick truck
Great. No more rolling them up and untangling them to use. Great price.
